as_told.title: Robert Hastings sees radar unknowns at Malmstrom

plain: Robert Hastings, author of a book about UFOs at nuclear weapons sites, says that as a teenager working as a janitor at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, home to nuclear missiles, a man at a radar desk called him over. According to Hastings, the man said they were tracking "unknowns", the formal term for unidentified objects, and Hastings saw five blips on the screen. Podcast host Jesse Michels retells it several times, calling the man an FAA supervisor (the Federal Aviation Administration runs civilian air traffic) or a radar operator, while Hastings dates it to March 1967, when his father was stationed there, and says this is what started his years of research.
